xpsaver.config.title: XP Saver Settings
xpsaver.config.live: Changes apply right away. No restart needed.
xpsaver.config.reset.title: Reset all XP Saver settings?
xpsaver.config.reset.message: Every setting on this screen goes back to its default. This cannot be undone.
xpsaver.config.color.heading: Headings
xpsaver.info.not_in_table: The enchanting table never offers this one: get it from loot, trading or fishing.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.protection: Cuts most kinds of damage, about 4% per level.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.fire_protection: Cuts fire and lava damage, and you stop burning sooner.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.blast_protection: Cuts damage and knockback from explosions.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.projectile_protec: Cuts damage from arrows, tridents and other projectiles.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.respiration: You can stay underwater longer before running out of air.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.aqua_affinity: Mine underwater as fast as on land.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.thorns: Sometimes hurts whoever hits you, but wears the armor down faster.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.frost_walker: Water under your feet turns to frosted ice as you walk, and magma blocks don't hurt you.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.binding_curse: Once worn, it can't be taken off until it breaks or you die.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.soul_speed: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil; the boots wear down while you do.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.sharpness: More damage with every melee hit.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.smite: More damage to undead mobs, such as zombies, skeletons and the Wither.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.bane_of_arthropod: More damage to spiders, cave spiders, silverfish, endermites and bees, and slows them down.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.fire_aspect: Hits set the target on fire.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.looting: Mobs you kill drop more items, and rare drops come more often.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.sweeping_edge: Sweep attacks hit nearby mobs harder.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.silk_touch: Blocks drop themselves instead of what they normally drop (stone instead of cobblestone, for example).
xpsaver.info.minecraft.unbreaking: The item uses up durability less often, so it lasts longer.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.fortune: More drops from ores, crops and some other blocks.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.infinity: Shooting doesn't use up regular arrows; you only need one in your inventory.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea: Better odds of catching treasure, such as enchanted books, when fishing.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.loyalty: A thrown trident flies back to you; higher levels bring it back faster.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.impaling: The trident does more damage to ocean mobs.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.riptide: Throwing the trident pulls you along with it, but only in water or rain.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.channeling: During a thunderstorm, a trident hit calls lightning down on the target, if it is under open sky.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.multishot: Fires three arrows for the cost of one; only one can be picked back up.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.density: Smash attacks do more damage for every block you fall.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.breach: Hits ignore part of the target's armor, 15% more per level.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.wind_burst: A smash attack bounces you back up into the air; higher levels bounce higher.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.lunge: A spear jab dashes you forward. Costs hunger, and doesn't work in water, while gliding or riding, or when you're too hungry.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.mending: XP orbs you pick up repair the item instead of adding to your level.
xpsaver.info.minecraft.vanishing_curse: The item disappears when you die instead of dropping.
